chapters.title: Space Glitch and Host Introductions
chapters.description: After a Twitter Space startup glitch, the hosts explain that waiting briefly can make a Space go live. Ishan, Anthony, and Scott welcome everyone to JavaScript Jam Live, introduce their Edgio roles, and preview a React Miami collaboration that preserves the open-mic format while inviting beginners and experienced developers to participate.

chapters.title: Guests and the Miami Jam Game Show
chapters.description: Dev introduces himself as a React Miami media partner, Michelle joins despite connection trouble, and a few listeners briefly appear. Dev then describes Miami Jam, a trivia-style show where React and JavaScript questions lead into speaker motivations and shared experiences, with audience scoring and participation. The discussion runs through 00:08:42.
